mapper.select: SELECT ci.id, ci.user_id, su.nickname AS user_name, ci.membership_id, ci.check_in_time, ci.check_in_type, DATE_FORMAT(ci.check_in_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS check_in_date, ci.created_at FROM check_in ci LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON ci.user_id = su.id WHERE ci.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ci.check_in_time DESC
